# Mediabunny

This directory distributes the unmodified ES module from Mediabunny 1.66.3 for local media processing. The package is licensed under MPL-2.0. The source code and build scripts are available in the corresponding [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mediabunny/v/1.66.3) and the [upstream repository](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny).

The bundled `mediabunny.mjs` is `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the npm tarball. SHA-256 `08d688058848bc432a02e11f6611a7de6935057a0460b82dc135c855f74ce750`. The extension loads the file locally.
